source_method: official GitHub releases / videolan.org release listing, read 2026-09-19

install_contract.scope: no explicit user/machine choice upstream (PrivilegesRequired=none); TigerSetup benchmark package offers both
install_contract.context_menu: Upload with ShareX (files); Explorer context menu
install_contract.startup: run at Windows start, off by default
install_contract.notes: AppMutex based single-instance refusal; all registry under HKCU

install_contract.scope: PrivilegesRequiredOverridesAllowed=dialog -> user/machine choice at install time
install_contract.context_menu: Explorer context menu integration, on by default
install_contract.notes: Windows 11+ installs shell extension as an MSIX package (WinMergeContextMenuPackage.msix) instead of classic regsvr32; large upgrade-hygiene delete list

apps.name: qBittorrent
apps.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (NOASSERTION on GitHub due to OpenSSL exception wording)
apps.canonical_source_note: No official portable/zip artifact exists for qBittorrent. Canonical payload is derived by extracting the NSIS installer's payload directly (7-Zip can unpack a stock NSIS installer without executing it), falling back to a Lab reference install if extraction proves unreliable.

install_contract.scope: machine only (all writes go to HKLM regardless of RequestExecutionLevel user)
install_contract.notes: No 'Bonus content' components in the 5.x line (that existed in older versions); running-instance check on install and uninstall

install_contract.context_menu: Play with VLC / Add to VLC playlist, on associated extensions and on Directory
install_contract.file_associations_note: 48 audio + 60 video + ~17 other extensions upstream; benchmark contract uses a representative subset (see package contract.md), not the full list
install_contract.discs_playback: ProgIDs + AutoPlay handlers for DVD/AudioCD/Bluray (excluded from benchmark contract as a documented simplification -- optical media handling is not materially comparable across the three technologies)
components_options: delete preferences and cache (uninstall-time, off by default)
install_contract.notes: Memento sections remember selection state across upgrades -- materially visible upgrade behavior worth exercising

gaps_and_limitations: qBittorrent has no official portable/zip artifact; canonical payload derived by extracting the NSIS installer rather than an upstream archive.

qBittorrent and VLC upstream installer scripts were read from project source at a recent branch HEAD, not the exact pinned tag; expected to match but not diffed line-for-line against the pinned release.

VLC's full file-association list (125+ extensions) is not reproduced verbatim in the benchmark contract; a representative subset is used and the simplification is documented in each package's contract.md.
